coverage.unsupported: Numbers, punctuation, diacritics and symbols are not supplied.

spacing.method: Full ink bounds receive positive side bearings, never a reduced advance. GPOS only adjusts measured pairs, with bounded corner tucks and no word-specific rules. Conservative one-unit Bezier control-hull envelopes cover both cubic and rounded quadratic outlines, expanded by one unit and compared across a 24-unit vertical neighborhood. Every adjusted horizontal gap is at least 24 units; vertically more distant ink is also at least 24 units apart. Small negative adjustments below eight units are omitted. Spaces receive no pair adjustment.
